text:
Rowan Kim: Quick design sprint for the benchmark launch: need a hero comparison tile (p95 latency vs cost), two social micro-tiles, and a webinar slide master with CTA -> form routing. Brand + a11y required. First drafts by Tue EOD.
Ivy Park: On it. Confirm metrics: p95, tokens/sec, cost/token? Any preference on viz (side-by-side bars vs sparkline)?
Devon Singh: Use p95, tokens/sec, cost/token. Side-by-side bars for hero. Sample numbers (for labels only): Hosted p95=340ms, t/s=160, cost/token=$0.0010; Dedicated p95=175ms, t/s=450, cost/token=$0.00055; Private p95=205ms, t/s=390, cost/token=$0.00048. Hosted as baseline.
Maya Lopez: Headline draft: "Serving wins: clearer cost, steadier latency". Also include a conservative copy layer: "Competitive latency and unit economics" for regulated channels.
Brand-Bot: Brand notes: Primary accent Approved Blue #0A6CF0. Logo clearspace required. Provide SVGs + flattened PNGs. Contrast: AA minimum, aim for AAA on small text. Avoid busy gradients under logo.
Ivy Park: Quick design Q: include a small micro-infographic tile that visualizes "cache + batching -> illustrative lower cost"?
Devon Singh: Yes, add a 1:1 micro tile with that line and a tiny percent example (e.g., "~30% lower in our test"). Legal will require a "see notes" link.
Brand-Bot: Accessibility: ensure green delta badge passes contrast; provide mono patterned fallback for print and SVG icon set. Include alt text for each asset.
Jordan Lee: Routing: slide CTA should tag leads with bench_launch_2026 and use utm_campaign=bench_launch. I will update routing once assets are uploaded; provide CSV mapping CTA->tag.
Ivy Park: Figma stub posted: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/bench-sprint. Export presets in file: hero 1200x630 PNG @2x, micro 1080x1080 PNG, slide master 1920x1080 (left gutter 96px).
Rowan Kim: Who owns copy QA & localization? Need APAC conservative strings by Thu AM.
Maya Lopez: I'll own conservative copy and hand to localization. Devon please reserve a 300x150px monospace code box on the slide for a sample query. Also include a dark-mode slide variant.
Devon Singh: Done. First frames will be up Mon EOB. Please post quick feedback here.
Rowan Kim: Thanks team 680. Tag Jordan when final exports are live.
Ivy Park: First frames posted: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/frame-1 4DD — comments welcome.
Jordan Lee: Noted. Will prep routing doc template and watch for the export zip.
Maya Lopez: Uploading conservative copy layer now.
